Mary - Album 1: Bloodlines

Wendy I Go

"Show me proof, show me data"

Musical direction: industrial skate-punk / math-rock edge, sewing-machine percussion, fluorescent-factory rhythm, sharper stop-start phrasing; 6_66 rebel-punk backbone with Wendy’s clinical, impatient, hyper-logical, unintentionally savage voice.

[Intro — sewing machines / fluorescent buzz / factory rhythm]

Needle down
Foot pedal
Thread pulls through

Seam
Cut
Measure
Repeat

Eight millimeters

Not nine

If you’re going to make me fix it
at least make the mistake interesting

[Verse 1]
South side wakes beneath the smokestacks
Before the daylight clears the roofs
Rent is late and dinner’s smaller
Nobody here needs extra proof

Everybody knows somebody
Working two jobs, maybe three
Making shirts they’ll never purchase
For a store they’ll never see

I used to sit inside a classroom
Calculus across the board
Correcting things my professor
Really wished I had ignored

He said, “Wendy, trust the method”

I said, “Your method gives you eight.”

He said, “That isn’t how we’re doing it.”

I said—

“Then you’re doing it wrong.”

[Pre-Chorus]
Numbers don’t get embarrassed
Physics doesn’t hold a grudge
Truth does not become less truthful
Just because you hate the judge

[Chorus]
Show me proof
Show me data
Give me something I can know

If it works
You can repeat it
If it doesn’t—

Let it go

Ghosts and curses
Signs and omens
Fairy tales from long ago

Can you prove it?

No?

Then thank you

That’s enough
I have to sew

[Verse 2]
College lasted less than planned for
Apparently I’m “difficult”

Apparently repeatedly proving
Faculty members wrong’s an insult

Could’ve stayed and learned to whisper
Could’ve smiled and played along

Could’ve paid tuition we don’t have
Just to let them stay wrong

So I left

Not quite the triumph
People put in graduation speeches

Family needed food and power
Not another stack of theses

Now I calculate the fabric
Optimize each wasted thread

Same equations
Different building

Same old brain
But cheaper rent

[Pre-Chorus]
Science doesn’t care who’s wealthy
Math won’t ask where you were born

Two plus two stays four in South Ridge
Even when your shoes are worn

[Chorus]
Show me proof
Show me data
Give me something I can know

If it works
You can repeat it
If it doesn’t—

Let it go

Luck and curses
Cards and palm lines
Things that frightened folks before

Prove your monster
Measure magic

Then we’ll talk

Until then—

No.

[Instrumental — sewing machines sync into guitars / bass run]

[Spoken over rhythm]

“Wendy.”

What?

“We need to talk.”

That sentence has never improved anything.

[Verse 3]
Shift is nearly done already
Last seam running through my hands

Supervisor standing by me
Holding paper like a man

Who rehearsed this conversation
Three whole times before he came

“We’ve received some complaints regarding—”

My work?

“No.”

Attendance?

“No.”

Accuracy?

“…No.”

Then this should be fascinating.

[Breakdown]

“Your attitude.”

…

My attitude makes the stitches crooked?

“No.”

It breaks the machines?

“No.”

It lowers production?

“No, but—”

Then scientifically speaking
we have identified no operational problem.

[Build — guitars climb]

He says customers
He says coworkers
He says words like “condescending”

I say—

Specific examples?

He says—

“Wendy, if you’d let me finish—”

Oh.

You’re firing me.

“Well—”

No.

[Final Chorus — full gang harmonies]
Wendy—

I GO!

Before you finish saying so

Keep your notice
Keep your meeting
Keep the speech you practiced slow

Wendy—

I GO!

I quit first
So now we know

You did not fire Wendy

Wendy—

I GO!

[Post-Chorus]
Clock me out
Cut the thread

Factory floor
Finished

Done

One less job
One small problem

Tomorrow?

I’ll calculate one

[Outro — factory gate / night air / music drops to keys]

Outside the compound
Streetlights flicker

Phone screen cracked
Battery twelve

Still works

Mostly

Contacts scroll beneath my thumb

No

No

Definitely no

…

Mary

…

Huh.

I haven’t thought about her in—

…

Wonder if she remembers me.

[Phone keypad tone]

[CUT]

TITLE NOTE — STRUCTURAL / FORESHADOWING:
Surface title function: Wendy interrupts the firing and declares “I GO.”
Embedded monster echo: “Wendy I Go” phonetically echoes “Wendigo.” This is deliberate title foreshadowing only. It does NOT by itself establish any in-story Wendigo reveal, species identity, or supernatural fact.
